title: Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 2020
ACT XIII OF 2020
SINDH SHOPS AND COMMERCIAL ESTABLISHMENT
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Sindh Shops and Commercial
Establishment Act, 2015
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
15th July, 2020]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-11/2020, dated 15.7.2020.---The Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment (Amendment) Bill, 2020
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th June, 2020 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 07th July, 2020 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Shops
and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment (Amendment) Act,
2020.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

2. Amendment
of section 24 of Sindh Act No. XII of 2014.---In the Sindh Shops and Commercial Establishment Act, 2015, hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 24,-
(a) for
subsection (2), the following shall be substituted:--
"(2)
An application for registration of an establishment shall be made by the
employer in Form. "A".";
(b) in
subsection (4), the words "and the fees" shall be omitted.
